definition_title: Weighted row and column domains for interpolation
natural_language_statement: Given real weights w_0, v_0, theta and w indexed by m coordinates, form column weights (w_0,w) and row weights (v_0,w/theta). The column domain is the finite real-weighted simplex at height H with column weights. The row domain is the product of Fin K and the strict weighted simplex at height H with row weights. These are the exact finite indexing domains used by the source interpolation matrix.
